name: novavei
description: NovaVei desktop — Tauri 2 + Luminous Quiet design

scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json --error-on-warnings
scripts.format:check: biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false src scripts vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.pack:portable: node scripts/portable-packaging-audit.mjs && tauri build --no-bundle -- --locked && node scripts/copy-portable.mjs
